description: Hosted REST API and MCP server providing YouTube transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist data at scale.
auth_notes: Authentication uses a Bearer token via the Authorization header with a TranscriptAPI API key.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up self-serve to receive 100 free credits with no credit card required, followed by paid plans starting at $5/month.
api_notes: Covers YouTube video transcripts, video search, channel search, channel video lists, latest uploads, and playlist extractions.
mcp_notes: Official YouTube MCP server provided by the vendor at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp supporting clients like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
rationale: The platform provides a fully documented REST API and official MCP server with self-serve free credential access and ready-to-use endpoints.

evidence.note: Shows cURL examples using Authorization: Bearer API_KEY
Details the 100 free credits trial and self-serve sign up process without requiring a credit card.
Lists endpoints for transcripts, search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction.
Provides the official vendor-hosted MCP server endpoint at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp
